Units: one row is one Jira TICKET for one marketplace app (not a Cycode code finding). Do not add these to Cycode counts.
Severity is the Jira 'Severity level' (P1 Critical, P2 High, P3 Medium, P4 Low). Cycode risk tiers do not apply.
M1: open tickets rated Critical or High. Open Medium is shown beside it because no ticket is currently above P3.
M2: weekly open backlog rebuilt from Created and Resolved dates.
M3: tickets closed as Patched, Created to Resolved. Duplicate, False Positive and Won't Fix are not remediation.
M4: share of all tickets closed as Duplicate or False Positive. Won't Fix is accepted risk and shown separately.
M5: age of open tickets in days; SLA breach = Remediation Due Date before the snapshot; hygiene = 100 x (1 - breaches / open tickets with a due date).
M6 and M7: not available. The Jira export has no actor or AI-verification field and no list of apps in scope.
M8: remediations per month only. The 140,000/year AI cost placeholder applies to Cycode, not to Ecoscanner.
M9: exposure = severity weight x 1.5 if overdue; score = 100 / (1 + exposure per app / median exposure per app). Relative, placeholder weights.
X10: open tickets by urgency (overdue, severity P3 or higher, due later, no due date).
X11: findings that repeat across apps (same scanner check or package + CVE): fix at the source once.
X12: Dependabot linkage. Manual links come from the analysis sample; imputed links follow the pattern (package, CVE, version group) and are flagged.
